items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Yeah, we used to play with all those times.

ctx.x: I like what little I've heard of him on record. Oh man, he played good. He sure did. Well, was Don Peterson any kind of you, the super-comer player? No, no, no, no, no, no. Another name I came across in the Union book was Louis Peterson, but he worked for the Boot and Shoe Workers. He would come and plead that the musicians should buy Union shoes and Union boots.

Yeah, no, no, no, no, no, no, no. Don Don played. Funny thing, I believe we had a brother by the name of Harold Peterson too. Yeah, we used to play with all those times. He sure did. We lived on Broadway and they lived on Broadway.
And he used to call out the mall. Oh yeah, that's huge. Did you ever go to the John Roof? Do you hear anybody up there? I don't know, Stratica.
